name: couple-tracker-backend
description: 情侶位置共享 App 後端服務

scripts.db:init: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const mysql=require('mysql2/promise');const dotenv=require('dotenv');dotenv.config();(async()=>{const c=await mysql.createConnection({host:process.env.DB_HOST,user:process.env.DB_USER,password:process.env.DB_PASSWORD,multipleStatements:true});await c.query('CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS '+process.env.DB_NAME);await c.changeUser({database:process.env.DB_NAME});const sql=fs.readFileSync('./models/init.sql','utf8');await c.query(sql);console.log('資料庫初始化完成');await c.end()})().catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1)})"
